sn42.13:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koḷiyesu viharati uttarannāma koḷiyānaṃ nigamo.
sn42.13:1.2: atha kho pāṭaliyo gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pāṭaliyo gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.13:2.1: ye te bhante evamāhaṃsu samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti. kacci te bhante bhagavato vuttavādino na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
sn42.13:2.3: ye te gāmaṇi evamāhaṃsu samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti. vuttavādino ceva me te na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
sn42.13:2.4: saccaṃ yeva kira bho mayaṃ tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ na saddahāma
sn42.13:2.5: samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti. samaṇo khalu bho gotamo māyāvīti.
sn42.13:2.6: yo nu kho gāmaṇi evaṃ vadeti ahaṃ māyaṃ jānāmīti. so evaṃ vadeti ahaṃ māyāvīti.
sn42.13:2.7: tatheva taṃ bhagavā hoti tatheva taṃ sugata hotīti.
sn42.13:2.8: tenahi gāmaṇi tañcevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā taṃ byākareyyāsi.
sn42.13:3.4: taṃ kiṃ maññasi gāmaṇi kimatthiyā koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭāti.
sn42.13:3.5: ye ca bhante koḷiyānaṃ corā te ca paṭisedhetuṃ yāni ca koḷiyānaṃ dūteyyāni tāni ca pahātuṃ etadatthiyā bhante koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭāti.
sn42.13:3.7: jānāsi tvaṃ koḷiyānaṃ nigame lambacūḷake bhaṭe sīlavanto vā te dussīlā vāti.
sn42.13:3.8: jānāmahaṃ bhante koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme ye ca loke dussīlā pāpadhammā koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā tesaṃ aññatarāti.
sn42.13:3.9: yo nu kho gāmaṇi evaṃ vadeyya
sn42.13:3.10: pāṭaliyo gāmaṇī jānāti koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme pāṭaliyopi gāmaṇī dussīlo pāpadhammoti sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti.
sn42.13:3.12: aññe bhante koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā aññohamasmi aññathādhammā koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā aññathādhammohamasmīti.
sn42.13:3.13: tvaṃ hi nāma gāmaṇi lacchasi pāṭaliyo gāmaṇī jānāti koḷiyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme na ca pāṭaliyo gāmaṇī dussīlo pāpadhammoti tasmā tathāgato na lacchati tathāgato māyaṃ jānāti na ca tathāgato māyāvīti.
sn42.13:3.14: māyañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi māyāya ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca māyāvī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.1: pāṇātipātañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pāṇātipātassa ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca pāṇātipātī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.2: adinnādānaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi adinnādānassa ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca adinnādāyī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.3: kāmesu micchācārañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi kāmesu micchācārassa ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca kāmesu micchācārī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.4: musāvādañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi musāvādassa ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca musāvādī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.5: pisuṇavācaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pisuṇavācāya ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca pisuṇavāco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.6: pharusavācaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pharusavācāya ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca pharusavāco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.7: samphappalāpañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi samphappalāpassa ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca samphappalāpī kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.8: abhijjhañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi abhijjhāya ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca abhijjhālu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ niyaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.9: byāpādapadosañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi byāpādapadosassa ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca byāpannacitto kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.10: micchādiṭṭhiṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi micchādiṭṭhiyā ca vipākaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca micchādiṭṭhiko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:5.1: santi hi gāmaṇi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
sn42.13:5.2: yo koci pāṇamatimāpeti sabbo so diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati
sn42.13:5.3: yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati sabbo so diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati
sn42.13:5.4: yo koci kāmesu micchācarati sabbo so diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati
sn42.13:5.5: yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatīti.
sn42.13:6.1: dissati kho ca pana gāmaṇi idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricārento.
sn42.13:6.3: ambho ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretīti.
sn42.13:6.5: ambho ayaṃ puriso rañño paccatthikaṃ pasayha jīvitā
sn42.13:6.7: tenāyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretīti.
sn42.13:7.1: dissati kho gāmaṇi idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno.
sn42.13:7.3: ambho ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindatīti.
sn42.13:7.5: ambho ayaṃ puriso rājaveriṃ itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā jīvitā voropeti
sn42.13:7.6: tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpāni kammakaraṇāni kārentīti.
sn42.13:8.2: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vāti
sn42.13:8.3: diṭṭhañca no bhante sutañca suyyissati cāti.
sn42.13:8.4: tatra gāmaṇi ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
sn42.13:8.5: yo koci pāṇamatimāpeti sabbo so diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatīti. saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vāti.
sn42.13:8.7: ye pana te tucchaṃ musā vilapanti sīlavanto vā te dussīlā vāti.
sn42.13:8.9: ye pana te dussīlā pāpadhammā micchāpaṭipannā vā te sammāpaṭipannā vāti.
sn42.13:8.11: ye pana te micchāpaṭipannā micchādiṭṭhikā vā te sammādiṭṭhikā vāti.
sn42.13:8.13: ye pana te micchādiṭṭhikā kallaṃ nu tesu pasīditunti.

sn42.13:20.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante ahu deva kaṅkhā ahu vicikicchā

sn42.13:21.1: alaṃ hi te gāmaṇi kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ
sn42.13:21.2: kaṅkhaniye ca pana ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannāti.
sn42.13:21.3: evaṃ pasannāhaṃ bhante bhagavati pahoti me bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyanti.
